name: manual_d72a91
claim: OpenClaw env.shellEnv imports only missing expected keys (core gateway keys, known provider auth, and known channels) from the login shell rather than the whole environment; custom keys like W&B are excluded and must reside in the trusted global env file, while shell aliases with dollar-brace expressions reach the gateway unexpanded.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit on PR 523: correct_lesson leaves corrections provisional by design; promote the verified shellEnv scope correction into an accepted superseding lesson so recall surfaces it.
